- [Triarch Malaquo](characters/triarch-malaquo.md): One of the three Triarchs of Volantis.

input.summary: Rickard rides to scout the south ford with Marro on foot at his stirrup (no spare horses). Marro spots fresh willow stakes marking the ford's shallow line, a skiff daubed tiger orange in the far reeds, and two hidden crossbowmen. He hauls Rickard's horse behind the dead willow while Rickard, unable to raise his shield, cannot defend himself; Marro then reaches for a dagger he no longer has and charges across with his cudgel, taking a bolt in the left thigh. The bowmen push off in their skiff and Rickard drags Marro out of the river.

updates.body: Fresh-cut willow stakes have been driven into the riverbed at the south ford, marking the shallow way across for men who don't know it. A flat-bottomed skiff with its bow daubed tiger orange was hidden in the far reeds.
Two crossbowmen waiting in the reeds at the south ford ambushed Rickard and Marro, then withdrew across the river in the tiger-orange skiff. Rickard says they knew where the company would look.
Marro took a crossbow bolt through the outside of his left thigh at the south ford. HP 4/6; -1 to physical rolls until it heals.
Rickard has a horse of his own and rides one-handed with his left arm strapped across his chest; he tried and failed to lift his shield at the ford.

thread_changes.title: Who marked the south ford?
thread_changes.body: Someone staked the shallow line of the south ford and left a tiger-orange skiff there, and set bowmen to watch the road from the camp. Could tie to who is selling the company's plans.
The ambush at the south ford suggests the Triarch's men know the company's scouting routes.

pc_changes.flaw_notes: Gambles when cornered. Swore to Hesse he never would again. Right hand: two fingers broken and splinted. Left thigh: crossbow bolt wound (ch-02).
